Source: https://github.com/markziemann/pathway_confint

## Libs

```{r,libs}

  library("GSVA")
  library("edgeR")
  library("kableExtra")
  library("gplots")
  library("fgsea")
  library("beeswarm")
  library("topconfects")
  library("fgsea")
  library("eulerr")

```

## Load gene expression data

From GEO https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE158420
GSE158420_counts.txt.gz

Data was cleaned according to another script `GSE158420_geneexpression_prep.Rmd`

```{r,loaddat}

x <- readRDS("GSE158420_counts_fixed.rds")

x[1:6,1:5]

```

## 1. Filter low-expression genes and normalise

```{r,filt_normalise}

y <- DGEList(counts = x)
keep <- filterByExpr(y)
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
y <- calcNormFactors(y)
y[1:6,1:5]

```

## 2. Calculate log-CPM expression values

```{r,logCPM}

expr <- cpm(y, log = TRUE, prior.count = 2)
expr[1:6,1:4]

## 3. Obtain reactome gene sets

```{r,reactome}

gmt_import <- function(gmtfile) {
    genesetLines <- strsplit(readLines(gmtfile), "\t")
    genesets <- lapply(genesetLines, utils::tail, -2)
    names(genesets) <- unlist(lapply(genesetLines, head, 1))
    attributes(genesets)$originfile <- gmtfile
    genesets <- genesets[lapply(genesets,length)>0]
    if( any(duplicated(names(genesets))) ) {
        warning("Duplicated gene sets names detected")
    }
    genesets
}

gs <- gmt_import("ReactomePathways_2026-10-23.gmt")

```

## 4. Run GSVA

```{r,run_gsva}

param <- gsvaParam(
    expr = expr,
    geneSets = gs,
    kcdf = "Gaussian",
    minSize = 5,
    maxSize = 500
)

scores <- gsva(param)

dim(scores)
scores[1:6,1:5]

```

## Samplesheet set up

```{r,samplesheet}

ss <- as.data.frame(colnames(x))
rownames(ss) <- ss[,1]
ss$patient <- factor(gsub("T","",gsub("N","",gsub("X","",ss[,1]))))
ss$tumor <- factor(grepl("T",ss[,1]))
ss[,1]=NULL
head(ss)

```

## Differential expression with edgeR

No adjustment for patient-of-origin effects.

```{r,edgeR1}

design <- model.matrix(~ tumor, data = ss)

fit <- limma::lmFit(scores, design)
fit <- limma::eBayes(fit)

results <- limma::topTable(
    fit,
    coef = "tumorTRUE",
    number = Inf,
    adjust.method = "BH"
)

head(results,10) |>
  kbl(caption="Top GSVA-limma results without sample pairing") |>
  kable_paper("hover", full_width = F)

```

Now with adjustment.

```{r,edgeR2}

design <- model.matrix(~ patient + tumor, data = ss)

fit <- limma::lmFit(scores, design)
fit <- limma::eBayes(fit)

results <- limma::topTable(
    fit,
    coef = "tumorTRUE",
    number = Inf,
    adjust.method = "BH"
)

head(results,10) |>
  kbl(caption="Top GSVA-limma results with sample pairing") |>
  kable_paper("hover", full_width = F)


gsva_up <- rownames(subset(results,logFC>0 & adj.P.Val < 0.05))
gsva_dn <- rownames(subset(results,logFC<0 & adj.P.Val < 0.05))

```

## Topconfects

```{r,topconfect_pw}

confects <- limma_confects(fit, coef="tumorTRUE", fdr=0.05)

head(confects$table,10) |>
  kbl(caption="Top pathway confident effect sizes") |>
  kable_paper("hover", full_width = F)

head(subset(confects$table,confect>0),20) |>
  kbl(caption="Top upregulated pathway confident effect sizes") |>
  kable_paper("hover", full_width = F)

head(subset(confects$table,confect<0),20) |>
  kbl(caption="Top downregulated pathway confident effect sizes") |>
  kable_paper("hover", full_width = F)

nrow(subset(confects$table,confect>0))

nrow(subset(confects$table,confect<0))

tcup <- subset(confects$table,confect>0)$name
tcdn <- subset(confects$table,confect<0)$name

plot(confects$table$effect,confects$table$confect)

```

## Compare topconfect results to the limma-GSVA

```{r,topcpnfect_compare}

m0 <- merge(results,confects$table,by.x=0,by.y="name")

head(m0) |>
  kbl(caption="merged file") |>
  kable_paper("hover", full_width = F)


plot(m0$logFC, -log10(m0$P.Value) )

```

## Show beeswarm chart of top pathways

Compare topconfects and GSVA-limma.


```{r,beeswarm1}

par(mfrow=c(3,3))
null <- lapply( confects$table$name[1:9],function(gsname) {
  dat <- scores[which(rownames(scores) == gsname),]
  ctl <- dat[grep("N",names(dat))]
  tmr <- dat[grep("T",names(dat))]
  xl <- list("ctl"=ctl,"tmr"=tmr)
  boxplot(xl,cex=0,col="white",
    ylab="Pathway activation",
    main=gsname, cex.main=0.8)
  beeswarm(xl,pch=19,col="darkgray",add=TRUE)
})

par(mfrow=c(1,1))

```

## FCS

```{r,fcs}

design <- model.matrix(~ patient + tumor, data = ss)

y <- DGEList(counts = x)
keep <- filterByExpr(y,group=ss$tumor)
y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
y <- calcNormFactors(y, method = "TMM")
y <- estimateDisp(y, design)
fit <- glmQLFit(y, design)
qlf <- glmQLFTest(fit, coef = "tumorTRUE")
res <- topTags(qlf, n = Inf)$table

fcs_score <- -log10(res$PValue) * sign(res$logFC)
names(fcs_score) <- rownames(res)

summary(fcs_score)

fres <- fgsea(pathways=gs, stats=fcs_score, minSize=5 )
fres <- as.data.frame(fres)
fres <- fres[order(fres$pval),]

head(fres,10) |>
  kbl(caption="Top pathways as prioritised by p-value") |>
  kable_paper("hover", full_width = F)

head(subset(fres,ES>0),20) |>
  kbl(caption="Top upregulated pathways as prioritised by p-value") |>
  kable_paper("hover", full_width = F)

head(subset(fres,ES<0),20) |>
  kbl(caption="Top downregulated pathways as prioritised by p-value") |>
  kable_paper("hover", full_width = F)

fres_sig <- subset(fres,padj<0.05)

fres_sig <- fres_sig[order(-fres_sig$ES),]

head(fres_sig,20) |>
  kbl(caption="Top upregulated pathways as prioritised by ES (after eliminating FDR>0.05)") |>
  kable_paper("hover", full_width = F)

fres_sig <- fres_sig[order(fres_sig$ES),]

head(fres_sig,20) |>
  kbl(caption="Top downregulated pathways as prioritised by ES (after eliminating FDR>0.05)") |>
  kable_paper("hover", full_width = F)

f_up <- subset(fres_sig,ES>0&padj<0.05)$pathway
f_dn <- subset(fres_sig,ES<0&padj<0.05)$pathway

```

## ORA

```{r,ora1}

upgenes <- rownames(subset(res,logFC>0 & FDR<0.05))
dngenes <- rownames(subset(res,logFC<0 & FDR<0.05))
bg <- rownames(res)

ores_up <- fora(pathways=gs,genes=upgenes,universe=bg,minSize=5)
ores_dn <- fora(pathways=gs,genes=dngenes,universe=bg,minSize=5)

o_up <- subset(ores_up,padj<0.05)$pathway
o_dn <- subset(ores_dn,padj<0.05)$pathway

```

## Compare

```{r,pw_euler}

jaccard <- function(x,y) {
  length(intersect(x,y)) / length(union(x,y))
}

jaccard(gsva_up,tcup)


# GSVA vs FCS
v1 <- list("GSVA_up"=gsva_up, "GSVA_dn"=gsva_dn,
  "FCS_up"=f_up,"FCS_dn"=f_dn)

plot(euler(v1),quantities = TRUE)

# ORA vs FCS
v1 <- list("ORA_up"=o_up, "ORA_dn"=o_dn,
  "FCS_up"=f_up,"FCS_dn"=f_dn)

plot(euler(v1),quantities = TRUE)

# GSVA vs ORA
v1 <- list("GSVA_up"=gsva_up, "GSVA_dn"=gsva_dn,
  "ORA_up"=o_up,"ORA_dn"=o_dn)

plot(euler(v1),quantities = TRUE)

# Compare all
v1 <- list("GSVA_up"=gsva_up, "GSVA_dn"=gsva_dn,
  "FCS_up"=f_up,"FCS_dn"=f_dn,
  "ORA_up"=o_up,"ORA_dn"=o_dn)

plot(euler(v1),quantities = TRUE)

```

## Compare confect to NES

GSVA confect vs FGSEA

```{r,scatter2}

plot(m$NES,m$confect,
  xlab="FGSEA NES", ylab="GSVA confect")
abline(v=0,h=0,lty=2,lwd=1)

plot(m$ES,m$confect,
  xlab="FGSEA ES", ylab="GSVA confect")
abline(v=0,h=0,lty=2,lwd=1)

plot(rank(m$NES)-table(m$NES>0)[1], rank(m$effect) - table(m$effect>0)[1] ,
  xlab="FGSEA NES rank", ylab="GSVA effect rank")
abline(v=0,h=0,lty=2,lwd=1)

plot(sign(m$ES)*-log10(m$pval),m$confect,
  xlab="FGSEA -log10(p)", ylab="GSVA confect")
abline(v=0,h=0,lty=2,lwd=1)

m2 <- m[!is.na(m$confect),]

m2$fprank <- rank( sign(m2$ES)*-log10(m2$pval) ) - table(sign(m2$ES)*-log10(m2$pval)>0)[1]
m2$NESrank <- rank(m2$NES)-table(m2$NES>0)[1]
m2$confect_rank <- rank(m2$confect) - table(m2$confect>0)[1]
m2$prankdiff <- abs(m2$fprank - m2$confect_rank)
m2$rankdiff <- abs(m2$NESrank - m2$confect_rank)

plot( m2$fprank, m2$confect_rank,
  xlab="Signed p-value rank",
  ylab="Signed confect rank")
abline(v=0,h=0,lty=2,lwd=1)

discrepant0 <- subset(m2,prankdiff>300)

plot( m2$fprank, m2$confect_rank,
  xlab="Signed p-value rank",
  ylab="Signed confect rank")
abline(v=0,h=0,lty=2,lwd=1)

points(discrepant0$fprank, discrepant0$confect_rank,
  pch=10,col="orange")

summary(discrepant0$size)
summary(m2$size)

plot(m2$NESrank, m2$confect_rank,
  xlab="FGSEA NES rank", ylab="GSVA confect")
abline(v=0,h=0,lty=2,lwd=1)

hist(m2$rankdiff)
nrow(subset(m2,rankdiff>300))

discrepant <- subset(m2,rankdiff>300)
discrepant <- discrepant[order(-discrepant$rankdiff),]

plot(m2$NESrank, m2$confect_rank,
  xlab="FGSEA NES rank", ylab="GSVA confect")
abline(v=0,h=0,lty=2,lwd=1)

points(discrepant$NESrank, discrepant$confect_rank,
  pch=10,col="orange")

head( discrepant , 20) |>
  kbl(caption="Discrepant prioritisation") |>
  kable_paper("hover", full_width = F)

summary(discrepant$size)
summary(m2$size)

cor(m$NES,m$effect)
cor(m$ES,m$effect)
cor(m2$NES,m2$confect)
cor(m2$ES,m2$confect)

# NES rank vs effect rank
cor(rank(m$NES)-table(m$NES>0)[1], rank(m$effect) - table(m$effect>0)[1] )

# ES rank vs confect
cor(sign(m2$ES)*-log10(m2$pval),m2$confect)

# FGSEA p-val rank vs confect rank
cor( m2$fprank, m2$confect_rank )

cor(m2$NESrank, m2$confect_rank)

```

```{r,NESsize1}

## Compare confect to ORA

GSVA vs ORA

```{r,scatter3}

dim(fres)
dim(ores_up)
dim(ores_dn)

ores_dn$foldEnrichment <- ores_dn$foldEnrichment * -1

o_comb <- lapply(ores_up$pathway, function(x) {
  upES <- subset(ores_up,pathway==x)[,"foldEnrichment"]
  dnES <-  subset(ores_dn,pathway==x)[,"foldEnrichment"]
  if ( abs(upES) >= abs(dnES) ) {
    subset(ores_up,pathway==x)
  } else {
    subset(ores_dn,pathway==x)
  }
} )

o_comb <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind,o_comb))

mo <- merge(o_comb,m0,by.x="pathway",by.y="Row.names")

head(mo)

# ORA fold enrichment vs GSVA confect
plot(mo$foldEnrichment,mo$confect,
  xlab="ORA FES", ylab="GSVA confect")
abline(v=0,h=0,lty=2,lwd=1)

# ORA fold enrichment vs GSVA effect
plot(mo$foldEnrichment,mo$effect,
  xlab="ORA FES", ylab="GSVA effect")
abline(v=0,h=0,lty=2,lwd=1)

# rank of ORA fold enrichment versus rank of GSVA effect
plot(rank(mo$foldEnrichment)-table(mo$foldEnrichment>0)[1], rank(mo$effect) - table(mo$effect>0)[1] ,
  xlab="ORA fold enrichment rank", ylab="GSVA effect rank")
abline(v=0,h=0,lty=2,lwd=1)

plot(sign(mo$foldEnrichment)*-log10(mo$pval),mo$confect,
  xlab="ORA -log10(p)", ylab="GSVA confect")
abline(v=0,h=0,lty=2,lwd=1)

mo2 <- mo[!is.na(mo$confect),]

mo2$oprank <- rank( sign(mo2$foldEnrichment)*-log10(mo2$pval) ) - table(sign(mo2$foldEnrichment)*-log10(mo2$pval)>0)[1]
mo2$FESrank <- rank(mo2$foldEnrichment)-table(mo2$foldEnrichment>0)[1]
mo2$confect_rank <- rank(mo2$confect) - table(mo2$confect>0)[1]
mo2$orankdiff <- abs(mo2$oprank - mo2$confect_rank)
mo2$rankdiff <- abs(mo2$FESrank - mo2$confect_rank)

plot( mo2$oprank, mo2$confect_rank,
  xlab="Signed ORA p-value rank",
  ylab="Signed GSVA confect rank")
abline(v=0,h=0,lty=2,lwd=1)

discrepant0 <- subset(mo2,orankdiff>300)

plot( mo2$oprank, mo2$confect_rank,
  xlab="Signed ORA p-value rank",
  ylab="Signed GSVA confect rank")
abline(v=0,h=0,lty=2,lwd=1)

points(discrepant0$oprank, discrepant0$confect_rank,
  pch=10,col="orange")

summary(discrepant0$size)
summary(mo2$size)

plot(mo2$FESrank, mo2$confect_rank,
  xlab="ORA FES rank", ylab="GSVA confect rank")
abline(v=0,h=0,lty=2,lwd=1)

hist(mo2$rankdiff)
nrow(subset(mo2,rankdiff>300))

```

  "-log10 p-val"=unname(mylm3$coefficients[2]),
  "GSVA log2FC"=unname(mylm4$coefficients[2]),
  "GSVA confect"= unname(mylm5$coefficients[2]))

barplot(slopes,ylab="Slope: prioritisation measure vs gene set size")
slopes

plot(log10(mo$size+1), abs(mo$foldEnrichment) / max( abs(mo$foldEnrichment)),
  xlab="log10 set size",ylab="Scaled FES",
  ylim=c(0,1))
mylm2 <- lm( abs(mo$foldEnrichment) / max( abs(mo$foldEnrichment)) ~ log10(mo$size+1) )
abline(mylm2,col="red",lty=2,lwd=2)
mylm2

plot(log10(mo2$size+1),-log10(mo2$pval) / max(-log10(mo2$pval)),
  xlab="log10 set size",ylab="Scaled -log10 pval",
  ylim=c(0,1))
mylm3 <- lm( -log10(mo2$pval) / max(-log10(mo2$pval)) ~ log10(mo2$size+1) )
abline(mylm3,col="red",lty=2,lwd=2)
mylm3

plot(log10(mo2$size+1),abs(mo2$effect) / max(abs(mo2$effect)),
  xlab="log10 set size",ylab="Scaled effect (log2FC)",
  ylim=c(0,1))
mylm4 <- lm( abs(mo$effect) / max( abs(mo2$effect)) ~ log10(mo$size+1) )
abline(mylm4,col="red",lty=2,lwd=2)
mylm4

plot(log10(mo2$size+1),abs(mo2$confect) / max(abs(mo2$confect)) ,
  xlab="log10 set size",ylab="Scaled confect",
  ylim=c(0,1))
mylm5 <- lm( abs(mo2$effect) / max(abs(mo2$confect)) ~ log10(mo2$size+1) )
abline(mylm5,col="red",lty=2,lwd=2)
mylm5

slopes <- c("FES"=unname(mylm2$coefficients[2]),
  "-log10 p-val"=unname(mylm3$coefficients[2]),
  "GSVA log2FC"=unname(mylm4$coefficients[2]),
  "GSVA confect"= unname(mylm5$coefficients[2]))

barplot(slopes,ylim=c(-0.1,0.2),
  ylab="Scaled slope: prioritisation measure vs gene set size")

slopes

abs(slopes[1])/abs(slopes[4])
abs(slopes[2])/abs(slopes[4])

```

Table of top results prioritised by different approaches:

```{r,prioritisation}

head(m[order(m$confect),],20) |>
  kbl(caption="Best down-regulated pathways by confect") |>
  kable_paper("hover", full_width = F)

head(m[order(-m$confect),],20) |>
  kbl(caption="Best up-regulated pathways by confect") |>
  kable_paper("hover", full_width = F)

```

## Compare confect to p-value

Directional question

Potential contradiction with logFC (GSVA) and ES (FGSEA).

```{r,direction_contradiction}

subset(m_sig2,adj.P.Val<0.05 & logFC < 0 & ES > 0) |>
  kbl(caption="bottom-right pathways") |>
  kable_paper("hover", full_width = F)

subset(m_sig2,adj.P.Val<0.05 & logFC > 0 & ES < 0) |>
  kbl(caption="top-left pathways") |>
  kable_paper("hover", full_width = F)

```
